name: Konayuki Fururi ~Yuzuhara-chou Curling-Bu~ Gaiden: Saeko no Kayoizuma Nikki
original_name: こなゆき ふるり～柚子原町カーリング部～ 外伝 冴子の通い妻日記
source:
Main character starts to live with Saeko. At first two friends are shy about holding hands and going on their first date, but soon their flirt is noticed by the acquaintances, so relations continue openly though not without teasing. This is a happy couple communal life diary.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公开始与冴子共同生活。起初，两名朋友连牵手和第一次约会都会害羞，但两人的亲密很快被熟人察觉，于是他们开始公开交往，尽管难免受到调侃。这是一篇幸福情侣的同居生活日记。
